title: Summarise an access log
prompt: data/access.log is a web server log in common log format. Write summarise.js so that `node summarise.js` writes summary.json with: requests (total lines), byStatus (an object from status code to count), topPaths (the three most requested paths as [path, count] pairs, most first, ties broken alphabetically; the path is everything before any "?"), and bytes (the sum of the response sizes, where "-" means 0). Run it to produce the file.
